tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything. A sisal neutral pulled toward the brand green, never pure white or grey.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: Ledgers, cards, inputs, the bottom nav and sheets: anything that holds records sits on sheet over paper.

tokens.name: sheet-sunk
tokens.usage: Inset wells on a sheet: tally buttons, the phone prefix, dry months in the season strip, loading skeletons. Never put ink-faint text on it.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between ledger rows and the 1px border of a sheet. Structure, not decoration.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (fields, secondary buttons, stepper) and the double rule above a ledger total. 3:1 on paper and sheet in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, figures and titles on paper, sheet and sheet-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Units after a figure, row metadata, secondary lines. 6:1 or better on paper, sheet and sheet-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, inactive nav labels, month letters. On paper and sheet only (4.5:1); not on sheet-sunk in light.

tokens.name: shamba
tokens.usage: The logo green. Fill of primary buttons, the profit band and the active tally. Light in dark mode, so it always pairs with on-shamba.

tokens.name: on-shamba
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a shamba fill (8:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: shamba-ink
tokens.usage: Green text: links, quiet buttons, the active nav label, good-news deltas. On paper and sheet.

tokens.name: shamba-tint
tokens.usage: Soft green fill: selected chips, the icon well of an enterprise tile, the Done tag.

tokens.name: maize
tokens.usage: Here and now, and nothing else: today's marker on the season strip and the active tab. Never text, never a large fill, never two meanings on one screen.

tokens.name: on-maize
tokens.usage: Text on a maize fill, in the rare badge that needs one.

tokens.name: maize-ink
tokens.usage: Maize as text, when a 'today' label must match the marker. On paper and sheet.

tokens.name: season-rain
tokens.usage: Rainy months (masika and vuli) on the season strip. Decorative: the month labels carry the meaning.

tokens.name: good-ink
tokens.usage: Positive state text and icons: Done, Paid, more than last period. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: good-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a good status tag.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Needs attention soon: Running low, Not recorded, Due. On warn-tint, paper and sheet (5:1+).

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a warning tag or alert icon well.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Act now or money lost: Below zero, Overdue, a loss. Always with a word or icon; never told from good by hue alone.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a danger tag or alert icon well.

tokens.name: rain-ink
tokens.usage: Weather and information: heavy-rain alerts, forecast text, neutral notices. On rain-tint, paper and sheet.

tokens.name: rain-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a weather alert or info tag.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 3px keyboard and switch-access focus ring, offset 2px. 3:1+ on paper and sheet in both themes.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The one key figure on a screen (profit, eggs today). Tabular lining numerals.

styles.name: figure-l
styles.usage: Figures in summary tiles and the tally stepper.

styles.name: figure-s
styles.usage: Right-hand figure of a ledger row.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Heavy rain expected Thursday, about 34 mm.
styles.usage: Default reading size for sentences: alerts, explanations, empty states.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Mama Njeri has owed you KSh 18,000 for 12 days.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Row titles, button text (16px on buttons), field labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Units, metadata and timestamps. The smallest size that carries information.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section stamps: the season, a ledger's period. Set in capitals in the copy itself.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Phone numbers being typed, sign-in codes, M-Pesa codes on entry.

styles.name: code-s
styles.usage: M-Pesa codes, animal tags and receipt numbers shown inside rows.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Figure to its unit; icon to its tag label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a title and its caption; chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a ledger row; gaps inside tiles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter and the inner padding of every sheet.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between ledgers and sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a screen's first section; around empty states.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Bottom padding above the nav so the last row clears a thumb.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable, rows included.

tokens.name: tap-primary
tokens.usage: Height of primary buttons, the phone field and tally buttons: the actions people take outdoors.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Inset wells: tally buttons, alert and enterprise icon wells, season months.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Sheets, ledgers, buttons and fields.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status tags and choice chips only. Buttons are never pills.

shadow.note: Depth comes from paper, sheet and rule. The one shadow lifts a bottom sheet over the screen.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and dialogs. Nothing else casts a shadow.
